title: No Version Control
description: Manual opt-in for tasks where the assigned work happens entirely in ignored, untracked, generated, runtime, or otherwise non-version-controlled files. Requires manual evidence because git diff/status cannot prove completion.

requirements.statement: The assigned task must be completed entirely through ignored, untracked, generated, runtime, or otherwise non-version-controlled files. Do not rely on git diff, git status, commits, or pull request evidence as proof of completion. Provide manual evidence instead, including exact files or paths touched, exact commands run, relevant command output, and any generated artifact or runtime state needed to verify the result.
